review_method: Parent/subagent contract review with failing cases for account06/account07/app09-app12; all cases verified against final committed source. No retained production change.

findings.finding: Own accepted queue invitations disappear from invitations(); matchId and actual matched cancellation outcome require authoritative snapshot reconciliation.
findings.fix: Fetch queueStatus.matchId / waiting invitation ID; preserve PLAYING and decline only an OFFERED invitation on explicit leave.

findings.finding: Asynchronous replies can outlive route, actor or match ownership and regress cached snapshots.
findings.fix: Fence generation, route, actor and match; cache only accepted snapshots; retire pagehide work; retain stable move retry keys.

findings.finding: A previous online actor or late profile read could survive authentication failure/account change.
findings.fix: Invalidate protected reads; increment online lifetime; destroy/rebind board and show sign-in while local modes remain playable.

findings.finding: Fresh game routes, transient polling and timeout settlement need resume paths.
findings.fix: Hydrate published activeMatch; expose Retry connection/focus/reconnect; retain confirmed FINISHED/VOID outcomes.

findings.finding: Online resignation/cancellation must preserve approved acceptance consequences and never automatically resign a found live match.
findings.fix: User confirmation of loss/agreed-pot/rating consequence before resignation; reconcile actual cancel outcome.

findings.finding: A corrected-password recovery retry must not re-verify a consumed OTP.
findings.fix: Preserve verified resetReady stage until completion or new flow; password/code remain memory-only.

findings.finding: Account action could claim success after failed protected profile read or miss another-tab linking.
findings.fix: Only linked profile produces success copy; explicit options refresh linked state.

findings.finding: Clean legal routes use the SPA, so no-JS support needs the preserved HTML fallback.
